summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC filed an 8-K reporting its subsidiary ADL CLO 3 LLC completed a $514.9 million term debt securitization (CLO) on August 6, 2026. The transaction involved issuing multiple tranches of senior secured floating-rate notes and subordinated notes, plus loans, with Citigroup and Apollo Global Securities as placement agents. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. No change in control, strategic transaction, or unusual event occurred. The filing works as a standard disclosure of a material agreement and direct financial obligation.
